searchForPattern: Search for a regex or literal pattern in project source files (grep-style).
reingestDocument: Force re-ingest a document by URL or document ID, replacing existing chunks.
deactivateProject: Deactivate a project, stopping its language servers and marking it archived.
searchCode: Semantic code search across indexed projects using natural language or code patterns.
uploadDocument: Ingest a local file into the knowledge base by providing its path on the server's filesystem.
webSearch: Search the web for current information using Perplexica. Returns AI-synthesized answer with sources.
checkFreshness: Check whether a document is still fresh (unchanged at source). Provide documentId, url, or area.
getProjectSummary: Get a summary of the project: file count, symbol count, relationship count, and last indexed time.
getCallGraph: Get the call graph for a symbol — who calls it (callers) or what it calls (callees), up to a given depth.
getDependencies: Get file-level dependency graph — which files depend on this file or which files this file depends on.
ingestDocument: Ingest a URL into the local knowledge base for later retrieval. Returns the document ID and initial status.
getInheritanceTree: Get the inheritance tree for a class or interface — shows ancestors (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS) and descendants.
registerProject: Register a project directory for code intelligence. Validates the path, detects languages, and starts indexing.
listAreas: List all defined areas in the knowledge base with their names, descriptions, and document counts. Use format='tree' to see the hierarchy.

deleteDocument: Permanently delete a document from the knowledge base by document ID or URL. Removes all chunks, area assignments, and schedules the storage file for deletion. This action is irreversible.

setProjectCredential: Store or remove a credential for an existing project. The credential is reused automatically on the next re-clone (e.g. updateProjectRef). Pass null or omit to remove an existing credential.

updateProjectRef: Switch a previously cloned project to a different branch, tag, or commit. Deletes the existing clone, re-clones at the new ref (reusing any stored credential), and triggers a full re-index. Indexing runs asynchronously.

registerProjectFromUrl: Clone a remote Git repository, register it as a project, and start indexing. Uses a shallow clone (--depth 1) for speed. Optionally provide a credential for private repos. Indexing runs asynchronously; poll getProjectStatus to track progress.

getServiceLogs: Return recent lines from the service log file (/tmp/codekeeper.log). Optional filters: level (e.g. ERROR/WARN/INFO), grep (case-insensitive substring), since (timestamp prefix, format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss). Returns the last `lines` matching entries (default 100).

configureArea: Configure the freshness refresh policy for a knowledge-base area. Set refreshEnabled=true to activate scheduled freshness checks, refreshIntervalDays to control the staleness window (e.g. 7 = weekly), and autoReingest=true to automatically re-ingest stale documents.

searchKnowledgeBase: Search the local knowledge base using hybrid semantic search. Returns ranked text chunks relevant to the query. Use minScore (0.0-1.0) to filter out low-relevance results. Use contextWindow (1-3) to include adjacent chunks for broader context around each result.
